takeaway: Visit scheduling is one controller (VisitController) that applies the date rules, attaches the visit through the Owner aggregate and saves it via OwnerRepository by cascade; there is no separate visit service or repository.

elements.name: Clinic user (browser)
elements.responsibility: Opens the visit form from the owner page and posts it

elements.name: Owners & Pets
elements.responsibility: Same component as in component-overview, opened up for the visit path

elements.name: GET/POST /owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}/visits/new
elements.responsibility: Provided HTTP interface for showing and submitting the visit form

elements.name: VisitController
elements.responsibility: Loads owner and pet, creates Visit, applies date rules (minVisitDate = today+1; reject date not after today), saves

elements.name: Visit form view
elements.responsibility: Thymeleaf form (date, description) plus previous visits; re-rendered with field errors

elements.name: Owner aggregate
elements.responsibility: Owner.addVisit(petId, visit) → Pet.addVisit; Visit defaults date to tomorrow, description @NotBlank max 255

elements.name: OwnerRepository
elements.responsibility: Spring Data JPA repository for Owner; findById, save

concern_details.detail: where the date rules are enforced
how a new visit is attached and saved
